title: ASC_project: Hidden Markov Model (HMM) Pipeline for Entropic Mind Analysis
summary: A research pipeline that models altered-state-of-consciousness time-series data with a custom multivariate-t HMM, PCA, and a neural decoder module. Its Simulated_data/Breathwork_sim.py script fits SDV's CTGANSynthesizer on breathwork data, builds a SingleTableMetadata schema, and calls evaluate_quality to generate and validate simulated tabular data for pipeline testing.
